info.title: TmfSpecificationGenerator
info.description: A .NET global tool that generates strongly-typed C# wrapper classes from TMF (TM Forum) specification JSON files with built-in validation and type safety.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file for the configuration

commands.name: generate-from-config
commands.description: Generates specification classes from a configuration file

options.name: --use-newtonsoft
options.description: Whether to use Newtonsoft.Json for serialization instead of System.Text.Json

options.name: --output
options.description: The output directory for the generated classes

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace for the generated classes

options.name: --input
options.description: The input directory containing the specification files in json format

options.name: --tmf-ver
options.description: The TMF API version to target

options.name: --generate-dependencies
options.description: Whether to generate dependency classes. Otherwise, you need to have CxOTmfAssertions.Commons referenced.

options.name: --include-version-in-classname
options.description: Whether to append the specification version (e.g. _1) to the generated class and proxy names.
